SELECT bm1.id, bm1.name, bm1.remark, bm1.image_url, bm1.state, bm1.view_code,bs.name AS sysModuleName FROM bi_module AS bm1 INNER JOIN bi_sys_module bs ON bs.id=bm1.sys_module_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bi_module AS bm2 WHERE code LIKE 'bi:indicator:%' AND bm1."id" = bm2."id")
AND (bm1.name LIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword},'%') OR bs.name LIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword},'%') )
${params.param}
ORDER BY bm1.create_time DESC

#{id}
